resources.string: What you’re on, tonight’s window and Start

During a Session, Doomread sees which app you open and, when your Work is on YouTube, whether Shorts is open, by the kind of screen. If it’s one of your Watched apps, it shows the “not yet” screen, with a way back to your Work and a way on to the app. It never reads the text on your screen or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone.
